plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: the square bottle anchors the left edge, a wide text column lets the headline run at full height with the subheadline on one line beneath, and the CTA sits on the right with the NEW / LIMITED RUN pills tucked under it as a single group.

Headline-first reading order: the copy leads on the left, the bottle sits in the middle with its launch pills right below it (product and badges grouped), and a tall CTA closes the strip on the right.
Eyebrow layout: the bottle on the left, the NEW / LIMITED RUN pills run as an eyebrow line above the headline in the centre column, and the CTA gets a full-height block on the right.
